channel.title: Austin Daily Herald - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Austin Daily Herald (austindailyherald.com)

item.title: ‘I can continue that work’
item.description: Joshua Whalen named new executive director of Matchbox Children's Theatre

item.title: Austin's final shot misses after furious effort against Raiders
item.description: Cole Hebrink scores 30 as Austin erases 12-point deficit, but his last-second three rims out in a 74-72 loss to Northfield on Austin Youth Basketball night.

item.title: Nelsen nets 24 as Vikings to KW
item.description: Rylan Nelsen pours in 24 points with four threes as Hayfield boys edge Kenyon-Wanamingo 68-61; Nolan Pack scores 20 and Charlie Walker adds 18 for the Vikings.

item.title: Austin girls basketball falls to Northfield 82-46 on the road
item.description: Austin girls basketball drops road game to Northfield 82-46, as Walsh and Cannon lead the Packers with 9 points each.

item.title: Rebel girls close out the regular season with a victory
item.description: Southland girls basketball ends its regular season with a 57-50 win over Spring Grove/Mabel-Canton, led by Juliette Matheis’ 23 points and Brynlee Koenigs’ 11 points and nine rebounds.

item.title: Viking girls beat Kenyon-Wanamnigo to win Gopher East
item.description: Hayfield/Schaeffer Academy tops Kenyon-Wanamingo 54-42 to clinch the Gopher East title; Lily Morrisey scores 18 as Vikings advance to Gopher Championship at New Richland-HEG Saturday.

item.title: Bruins' 8-game winning streak comes to an end in Iowa
item.description: Austin Bruins’ eight-game win streak ends with 4-1 road loss to North Iowa Bulls in Mason City, managing their lone goal in the third period despite 20 saves from Jack Solomon.

item.title: Rebel boys win 15th straight game
item.description: Southland boys top Burros 58-51 in Lanesboro to extend win streak to 15, improve to 20-1 with two regular-season games left; Henry Wiste scores 19 to lead Rebel boys.

item.title: Blue Devil men take down St. Cloud
item.description: No. 2 Riverland tops St. Cloud Tech 67-63 in home finale, improving to 26-1; Tristan Coleman leads Blue Devils with 22 points and 11 rebounds.

item.title: Blue Devil women drop 19th straight game
item.description: Riverland women’s basketball falls 72-33 to St. Cloud at home, extending winless season to 0-19.
